```{r}
# ── F.3 Preferred Cost Allocation ────────────────────────────────────────────

library(patchwork)

summary_data_f3 <- mlogit_clean %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(Cost.Allocation != "Other (Please enter answer in the box)") %>%
  group_by(Zipverified, Cost.Allocation) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Zipverified) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    prop  = n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Zipverified = factor(Zipverified,
                         levels = c("Resident", "Tourist"),
                         labels = c("Residents", "Tourists"))
  )

tourist_data  <- summary_data_f3 %>% filter(Zipverified == "Tourists")
resident_data <- summary_data_f3 %>% filter(Zipverified == "Residents")

custom_colors <- c(
  "Both, but majority residents" = "#6a906c",
  "Both, but majority visitors"  = "#ae9864",
  "Both, equally"                = "#503440",
  "Only Residents"               = "#7b9f9f",
  "Only Visitors"                = "#031812"
)

p1 <- ggplot(tourist_data, 
             aes(x = 2, y = prop, fill = Cost.Allocation)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 1), "%")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size  = 2.5,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(title = "Tourists", fill = "Cost allocation") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p2 <- ggplot(resident_data, 
             aes(x = 2, y = prop, fill = Cost.Allocation)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 1), "%")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size  = 2.5,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(title = "Residents", fill = "Cost allocation") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 7.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

f3 <- p1 + p2 +
  plot_annotation(
    title  = "Who do you think should bear the majority of the cost for trail management?",
    theme  = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave(
  filename    = "Figure_F3_CostAllocation.tiff",
  plot        = f3,
  width       = 160,
  height      = 100,
  units       = "mm",
  dpi         = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_F3_CostAllocation.pdf",
  plot     = f3,
  width    = 160,
  height   = 100,
  units    = "mm"
)

print(f3)
rm(summary_data_f3, tourist_data, resident_data)
```
